The '''''Inferno''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was featured in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', a tactical manual compiled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as an example of a standard [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] for a section detailing the Imperial Navy's primary [[Warship/Legends|warships]].

==Description==
A product of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], the ''Inferno'' was a 1,600-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Imperial-I" /> Its powerful main battery consisted of six [[Heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|heavy turbolaser turrets]] and two [[Ion cannon/Legends|heavy ion cannon turrets]]. Numerous smaller [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] provided an anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] defensive screen, while additional ion [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] and [[Q7 tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]] rounded out the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] armaments.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

The ''Inferno'' [[Carrier/Legends|carried]] a full [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters, organized into six [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of seventy-two total fighters. The fighter complement included [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptors]], and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|bombers]]; additional [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboats]], and other [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were also carried aboard.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

For [[Planet/Legends|planetside]] operations, the ''Inferno''{{'s}} arsenal included twenty [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] and many smaller [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], along with [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] them. Nearly 37,000 [[Human/Legends|men]] comprised the ''Inferno''{{'s}} crew, with an additional 9,700 ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

A [[I-a2b solar ionization reactor/Legends|solar ionization reactor]] provided power to the ''Inferno'', enabling its three primary [[Destroyer-I ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] and four supplemental [[Gemon-4 ion engine/Legends|thrusters]]. Two [[ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome|sensor and communications globes]] atop the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] doubled as [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

==History==
The ''Inferno'' was one of the tens of thousands of Imperial Star Destroyers serving in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It had entered service by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], prior to the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution of the Imperial Senate]].<ref name="Date" />

The Star Destroyer was featured in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', a tactical manual compiled in preparation for the completion of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] and distributed just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The ''Inferno'' was depicted in a section entitled "Imperial Navy Ships of the Fleet," authored by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], where it provided a visual example of the standard Imperial Star Destroyer.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Inferno'' appears in the [[2014]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] as an [[in-universe]] set of tactical procedures and mission reports for all newly ascending Imperial [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanders]]. The Star Destroyer's illustration was provided by artist [[Joe Corroney]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> In [[2019]], 3D artist [[Ansel Hsiao]], known for his work on ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', complained that some of the artwork published on his [http://fractalsponge.net website] were reused without his consent by Corroney for the ''Imperial Handbook''. Such artwork included the illustration of the ''Inferno''.<ref name="Fractal">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/?p=4224|text=Hey, Disney and Joe Corroney|author=[[Ansel Hsiao|Hsiao, Ansel]]|date=2019-02-16|archivedate=20190224032232}}</ref><ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=fractalsponge|url=fractalsponge/blog/wAWe/turns-out-desaturate-in-photoshop-is-great|name=[[Ansel Hsiao]]|text=Turns out, desaturate in Photoshop is great.}}</ref>

The ''Imperial Handbook'' depicts the ''Inferno'' as a standard example of an Imperial Star Destroyer for the book's section on Imperial Navy [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. The ''Inferno''{{'s}} illustration accompanies a brief outline detailing the various armaments and battle complements of the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer;<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> as such, this article applies these specifics to the ''Inferno'' itself.
